required_items.evidence: production-deployment workflow in one selected pilot repository
platform engineering or DevSecOps workflow owner
SMERC scores actions and emits artifacts without blocking workflow execution
no secrets, credentials, raw customer records, source bodies, private prompts, or regulated payloads
security owner can pause or stop the pilot
reviewer agreement, false release, false constraint, useful constraint, latency, and override metrics

smerc_provides: local scoring or API scoring path
posture, reason code, score, and control output
evidence_boundary: Handoff checklist only. It does not prove customer demand, production safety, compliance readiness, or incident reduction.
